CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_st5_adl(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0286 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0287 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0288 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	target_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0286_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0287_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0288_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	target_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0286_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0287_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0288_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	target_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0286_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0287_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0288_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_st5_adl WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_st5_adl (
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286','1B0287','1B0288')  ,t.cid,NULL)) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0286
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0287')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0287
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0288')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0288

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280') ,l.cid,NULL)) result_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0286_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0287')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0287_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0288')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0288_1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281') ,l.cid,NULL)) result_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0286_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0287')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0287_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0288')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0288_2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1282') ,l.cid,NULL)) result_3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=3 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0286_3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=3 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0287')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0287_3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=3 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0288')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0288_3

FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
LEFT JOIN t_adl_last_regist l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280','1B1281','1B1282')
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_st5 t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND LENGTH(TRIM(p.CID)) = 13
AND p.age_y >=60 AND p.age_y < 200
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;

SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,p.age_y
,IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280'),'ติดสังคม',
	IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281'),'ติดบ้าน',
	IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281'),'ติดเตียง',''

,IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0286','1B0287','1B0288') ,'ได้รับการคัดกรอง','') result

INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
LEFT JOIN t_adl_last_regist l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280','1B1281','1B1282')
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_st5 t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND LENGTH(TRIM(p.CID)) = 13
AND p.age_y >=60 AND p.age_y < 200
);
